# Frontier Release Factory Records

Observation-only record types contributed by `frontier-release-beam-pack`.
No `bpma:AdmittedActuation` individuals are defined by this pack: these
records confer no repository-creation, deployment, publication,
communication, or spending authority. Full per-field reference for each
type lives in `docs/reference/beam4pm_types_reference.md` (rendered by
`beam4pm-process-model-pack`'s own templates over the same merged graph).


- `frontier_benchmark` — Executable comparison contract produced from a frontier announcement.

- `frontier_evidence` — Exact-subject verifier/replay evidence supporting an earned frontier-response claim.

- `frontier_opportunity` — DfCM-selected bounded response opportunity derived from an observed release.

- `frontier_source_release` — Observed external frontier announcement with provenance and extracted-claim payload; observation only, never authority.
